mapper.select: select j.id, j.tenant_id, j.job_code, j.instance_status, j.started_at, j.finished_at, j.expected_partition_count as expected_partitions, frozen.workflow_run_id, frozen.node_code, p.id as pipeline_instance_id, p.run_status as pipeline_status, p.current_stage, coalesce(p.system_pipeline_code, frozen.pipeline_code) as system_pipeline_code, coalesce(p.system_pipeline_version, frozen.pipeline_version) as system_pipeline_version from batch.job_instance j left join batch.pipeline_instance p on p.related_job_instance_id=j.id and p.tenant_id=j.tenant_id left join lateral ( select n.workflow_run_id, n.node_code, r.execution_snapshot->'jobDefinitions'->n.node_code->>'systemPipelineCode' as pipeline_code, (r.execution_snapshot->'jobDefinitions'->n.node_code->>'systemPipelineVersion')::integer as pipeline_version from batch.workflow_node_run n join batch.workflow_run r on r.id=n.workflow_run_id where n.job_instance_id=j.id and r.tenant_id=j.tenant_id and r.execution_snapshot->>'schemaVersion'='2' order by n.id desc limit 1 ) frozen on true where j.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and j.id=#{id}

select 'PARTITION' as scope, partition_status as status, count(*) as count from batch.job_partition where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and job_instance_id=#{id} group by partition_status union all select 'TASK', task_status, count(*) from batch.job_task where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and job_instance_id=#{id} group by task_status order by scope, status

select distinct on (s.stage_code) s.stage_code, s.step_status as stage_status, s.id as step_run_id, s.run_seq, , pr.updated_at as last_heartbeat_at, s.error_code from batch.pipeline_step_run s join batch.pipeline_instance p on p.id=s.pipeline_instance_id
left join batch.pipeline_progress pr on pr.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and pr.pipeline_instance_id=#{pipelineId} and pr.stage=s.stage_code where p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and p.id=#{pipelineId} order by s.stage_code,s.run_seq desc,s.id desc
